newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tobishima losses pared after early tumble.
newsitem.headline: Tobishima losses pared after early tumble.

text.p: Shares in Tobishima Corp recovered slightly after tumbling to a limit low earlier on Friday afternoon.

Losses had accelerated despite the construction firm's denial of rumours that it might be applying for court protection from its creditors. The firm's shares started to bounce back on news that Fuji Bank, a major creditor bank, said that a restructuring programme for the firm was making progress.

As of 0606 GMT, the share price was down 40 yen at 161. It briefly dipped to a limit low of 121 yen earlier in the afternoon. Turnover was 8.49 million shares, the third heaviest on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
